Core types — no external imports, all func. Everything else in the project builds on these.

Types

ChannelKind = enum
  ckTelegram, ckDiscord, ckWeCom, ckWeChat, ckQQ, ckFeishu, ckSlack, ckWhatsApp,
  ckSignal, ckDingTalk, ckMatrix, ckEmail, ckCli
Identifies which messaging channel a message arrived on / should be sent to. Source   Edit   
ChannelPrefs = object
  provider*: string
  model*: string
  thinking*: string
  budget*: string
  reasoning*: string         ## "on" | "off"
User preferences for a channel. Defined in core so app/domain can use it without depending on the adapter. Parsing lives in adapters/channel/. Source   Edit
